generator.prompt: THROWAWAY (Phase 1 bake-off, Violet glow-up, round 9): driver helpers for round 9's scarf-only repaint pass, fixing round 8's kept gap 1 (the scarf redrawn every frame, some frames a flat untextured light-gray fill, and land frames 4-6 swapping from in front of the body to behind it). freeze() copies a live frame + its sidecar to <name>.round-NN.<ext> before it gets overwritten (rounds.md's Frozen inputs convention); repoint_shot_inputs() re-points an existing shot record's stale generator.inputs paths at the frozen copies, same bytes/hash; finalize_scarf_only() generalizes finalize_run_scarf_fix.py's recipe (crop the raw regen to its own alpha bbox, rescale by the shared rig_per_raw, compute scarf_offset_final against the frame's own recorded union_bbox_orig_1024canvas) to any anim/index; grade_scarf_inplace() applies grade_b.py's grade_scarf directly; measure_std() is the pixel std of luminance inside the scarf's opaque interior used to identify flat/untextured frames.
